correctness.rationale: The proof derives exact cyclic mixed-window identities from alternating zero/one runs and directly identifies pure-trimer extras. Necessity gives p≡q (mod 3) and sharp boundary p≥2 for a>0, q≥2 for d>0. Sufficiency constructs every admissible profile using A=(2p+q)/3, B=(p+2q)/3 and r=ceil(max(A,B)/2) alternating runs. The rational series follows by a residue-class generating sum; its partial fractions prove exact counts, period and asymptotics. Direct exhaustive enumeration through n=16 and independent de Bruijn-state DP through n=48 confirm every attainable quadruple and its count. Finite checks are not claimed as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The exact image of cyclic binary length-three composition histograms and its generating function are not stated by the inspected primary works on linear length-limited composition reconstruction, full linear composition reconstruction, or ordered cyclic substring reconstruction. value.rationale: The observation is the natural unordered-composition-only cyclic trimer read channel, relevant to molecular-spectrum reconstruction. Its full image, not merely a few cases, is resolved by a sharp modular congruence and two nontrivial boundary constraints; an exact cubic quasipolynomial yields both the one-third density of realizable abstract output histograms and the exact zero-error coding cardinality. Distinct from prior pair profiles and linear all-short-read composition models.
